impact: Encrypts files on the compromised machine and demands ransom for file decryption
mitigation_measures: Keep all AV and IPS signatures up to date
Leverage Fortinet solutions designed to train users to understand and detect phishing threats
Implement foundational changes to the frequency, location, and security of data backups
Investigate cloud-based security solutions, advanced endpoint security, and Zero Trust Access
related_malicious_code_snippet: The method Cryptonite uses to encrypt files is via the Python Cryptography module. It uses an implementation of Fernet to provide 128-bit AES against the whole of a targeted file.
